Maya: grabbing the 11:30 'orange rail' slot today — small infra rollout: batching defaults tweak + feature-flagged schema change. ETA 11:30-11:45 PST. Need a smoke owner and a rollback watcher. @Denise heads-up for DB snapshot timing.

Rajeev: can you confirm canary %, and what the rollback path looks like? also any consumer-facing risk?

Maya: canary 5% on west region only. Rollback plan: 1) flip feature flag off 2) restore KV cache shards if anomaly 3) rollback migration (we have no destructive changes). Health checks: 200s for /health, tail 1m error-rate <1%.

Denise: DB snapshot scheduled 11:15 PST — I started a pre-snapshot test. If we need to revert, we have snapshot + binlog. I'll be on call for 11:10-12:00.

Taylor: I'll take smoke owner duty. Will run the checklist and post results. :thumbsup:

Maya: awesome — TY. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- smoke: hit /health and /api/v1/generate at 3 qps for 30s
- compare token-latency median < 120ms
- run small end-to-end: sample prompts -> validate outputs contain expected keys
- run canary load: curl -H "x-canary: true" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```

Kai: ping re: release board — have you updated the release train ticket? we need to mark 11:30 occupant so next slot knows to avoid conflict.

Maya: updated ticket RT-4876 and added rollback steps. Also added tag `orange-rail/2026-03-18`.

deploy-bot: deploy window check: slot reserved 11:30-11:45 by Maya — no conflicts detected. :robot_face:

Rajeev: ack. If smoke passes, please bump canary to 20% after 15m and monitor for 30m before full rollout.

Taylor: will post quick pass/fail and logs in thread. I'll ping if I see anything odd.
